title: Columbus uses a predicted eclipse to make island natives feed his crew
place_text: West Indies (speaker says the Bahamas; historically Jamaica)

tellings.quote: so, you know, Chris Columbus had said, "If you do not do what we ask, we will block out your son in 3 days time. You have 3 days." Mhm. And so, 3 days later, sure enough, there was a solar eclipse.

plain: Christopher Columbus is said to have told island natives that if they did not do what his crew asked, he would block out the sun in three days, and three days later a solar eclipse came, so they gave in. The video maker Chris Ramsay tells it, placing it in the Bahamas and linking it to the science fiction writer Arthur C. Clarke. He uses it to show how a group with advanced knowledge can seem to have magic power over others.
